etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: Learned borrowing from Latin lachrymōsus, lacrimōsus, from lachryma, lacrima (“tear”) + -osus (“-ful”), from Old Latin dacrima, from Proto-Indo-European *dakru-, cognate with English tear.
senses: Tearful, sorrowful, sad, pertaining to tears, weeping, causing tears or crying.
